record_requirements: A real Windows GUI action was performed by the operator and the visible result was inspected.
Each evidence reference must point to a non-empty screenshot or copied GUI log/output beneath the approved evidence root.
Evidence bytes and SHA-256 are captured by the canonical recorder and re-verified before acceptance.
Ledger events are hash-chained; later corrections append an event and never silently replace an earlier event.
Each PASS event requires explicit operator attestation and timestamp plus the exact surface, capability and action.
Renderer activation, media creation and release authority remain false/NONE for this no-media acceptance stage.
A D9.15 checkpoint can close operational GUI acceptance only; it cannot authorize D4.8, renderer, D9.14 media, D9.16 full acceptance, D9.17 closure or baseline freeze.
